headline: Silver Falls 3.53 Percent to $48.93 as Copper Drops 2.79 Percent and Oil Rises 1.52 Percent
narrative: Silver fell 3.53 percent to $48.93 and gold fell 1.39 percent to $3,914.5, money leaving the precious-metals pipe. Copper fell 2.79 percent to $6.36, the industrial-metals pipe selling in the same move. Oil rose 1.52 percent to $97.93 and took that bid, while the S&P 500 eased 0.51 percent to 7,541.4.
author: jordan
